Exness wrap-up

The organizational command structure hasn't changed one bit.

For better or worse, it is undoubtedly the world's No.1 FX broker.

There were IB partners from many different countries.

Japan 🇯🇵 is a cash-cow, profitable region, so I'd like them to try a bit harder, but I suppose that's impossible.

I thought something was off, and my Exness cent account has stopped at the 100-position limit 😅
Have to start over from scratch again 😹

I got what seems like a good notice from Exness, but the details are so unclear that I have to check, a double-handling notice.

Also, that Onamae threatening-email thing is scary. I'd like to go to the address listed, but I'm too scared to access it, so 秋 (unclear, possibly a typo).
I can't log in to Exness. 😅

[I was seriously panicked. The story of Exness suddenly becoming unusable]

This morning I couldn't log in to either Exness MT5 or the Personal Area.

I had just changed my password yesterday.

"Did someone gain unauthorized access and drain my funds!?"

For a moment, I seriously felt the blood drain from my face.

When I hurriedly checked my email, there was a security notice from Exness.

It said:

① Forced logout from all devices and trading platforms

② Personal Area password reset

③ MT5 trading password also reset

④ Read-only password also reset

Apparently Exness took emergency measures to protect accounts.

However, it is unclear whether this applies to all users or only my account.

Honestly, I very much welcome this kind of response.

In fact, considering this unauthorized access commotion, I think all brokers should do it.

Protecting customer funds is overwhelmingly more important than the inconvenience of being temporarily unable to log in.

Were your Exness accounts also forcibly reset, everyone?

Huh, seriously⁉️

I still have about 4 million yen in my Bitget wallet, and this is honestly really scary.

But then, where else would it be safe to move it to?

Should I move it to my Exness wallet, whose password I just changed this morning?

Crypto is scary.
Banks are scary.
Overseas FX is scary.

I no longer know what to trust or where to keep my assets.

Where is everyone moving their assets to?
